title: Hanasato Minori — Late-Night MC Training〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Beyond The Dream of That Day

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, it's almost time!
I'll start the group call... Now!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Geez, you don't have to shout. We can hear you just fine.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
<Um... Am I connected?
Can you all hear me?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Since we're all here, we can chat for a bit before the show starts.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <I know my suggestion was really sudden, so thank you all for agreeing to watch iHaz with me.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<No worries.
I was actually pretty interested in watching.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Me too. And chatting while watching sounded like so much fun.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <I agree. When you suggested that we watch it together, Minori, I was immediately for it. If anything, we should be the ones thanking you.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<Whoa...!
I can't see your face, but I'm overwhelmed by your dazzling aura just after hearing you say that...!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Also, aren't you getting a little too excited for your own good? You might end up crashing, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Oof... You're right. I'm usually so tired by the time this show airs that I prefer to record it instead...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <However, we're all here to watch it as it airs tonight, so I vow not to fall asleep!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Alright, we get it. Just don't push yourself too hard, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
<Oh, Minori, that reminds me.
You watch this show often, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <I know you already gave us an overview of it when we were at school, but do you think you could tell us a little more about it?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<Yeah, of course!
So, I'm pretty sure that I mentioned how various idols from different groups lead the show each week.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Yes, you did. You also mentioned how seeing idols from different groups interacting with one another is one of this show's best features.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Exactly! A lot of them are meeting each other for the very first time, but they become really good friends sometimes after doing a segment together.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Interesting... That's kind of refreshing since groups don't usually get to meet and interact unless they belong to the same agency.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <I know, right? Not only that, it's sorta become normal lately for iHaz to trend on social media whenever it starts.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Which means just that many people are talking about it...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Also, because so many different idols appear on this show, it can become an opportunity for people to find new favorites.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Which is why I'm hoping that more people will decide to support us after seeing us on iHaz.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Speaking of which, Haruka, you already responded to that producer's email, right?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <I did. They said they'll contact us again later since they still don't know who else is going to appear alongside us.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Hehe. I can't wait to find out who that is...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<I-I'm okay! I'm not sleepy at all! Sleep...
*Yawn*>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Oh, Minori... You don't have to force yourself to stay up if you don't think you can...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <B-But I wanna watch iHaz with all of you!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <And I'm sure I'll be wide awake after I see the opening since it's always so fun!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Alright, I guess we have no choice...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Haruka, can you wake Minori up by giving her a dose of your idol power?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh...?! H-H-H-Haruka?!
What are you doing in my room?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. What you're seeing right now is my idol aura. I'm actually still in my room.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When you've been an idol for as long as I have, you acquire these sorts of abilities.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, it worked!
I can do it too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too! Hehe. I'm glad we decided to give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You too, Airi, Shizuku?!
Wh-What about me...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm sure you can now, Minori.
Let's try practicing before iHaz starts.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let my idol aura build up inside of me... Build and... Mhm...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <She was going in and out when we were talking about who's going to be appearing with us.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <That's exactly why I warned her about crashing.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Luckily, she'll be able to watch it online later. For now, let's just enjoy the show...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Right. Especially since she seems to be having a fun dream.>
